citations.quote: You can make an Opportunity Attack when a creature that you can see leaves your reach. To make the attack, take a Reaction to make one melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against that creature. The attack occurs right before it leaves your reach.
citations.section: SRD 5.2.1 p.15 'Playing the Game > Making an Attack > Opportunity Attacks > Making an Opportunity Attack'

why: Provokes an Opportunity Attack: a creature you can see leaves your reach using its own movement.
